newsitem.title: GERMANY: German officials to pay tribute to Ludwig Erhard.
newsitem.headline: German officials to pay tribute to Ludwig Erhard.

text.p: Chancellor Helmut Kohl, senior German government officials and Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer will attend a celebration marking the 100th birthday of former Chancellor Ludwig Erhard in Bonn on Wednesday.

The celebration to honour Erhard, known as the father of Germany's economic miracle, will begin at 1000 GMT. Kohl is scheduled to deliver a speech at 1105 GMT. A discussion will be held at 1400 GMT and is scheduled to end around 1600 GMT.

Finance Minister Theo Waigel will lead the discussion about Erhard's legacy with Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer, Economics Minister Guenther Rexrodt and former finance minister Gerhard Stoltenberg.

Erhard, who would have been 100 years old on February 4, became a legend here by introducing the deutschemark in 1948, liberalising West Germany's shattered economy and developing a "capitalism with a social conscience".
